Post-seal, adjudicated with the gate left byte-unedited: C4 (the control's mutation path kept the raw-text bug the assertion path had been fixed for, so it certified P2 while testing nothing) and G5 (diffed committed history while the fixes were uncommitted, so it passed vacuously and would have passed had a fixer rewritten .github/). One further wrong instrument was the conductor's own: the adjudication artifact's column K trimmed the whole `git status --porcelain` block before slicing, which strips the leading space off the FIRST line only and shifted one path by one character — caught because column K disagreed with column H, which measures the same fact by a different command.
